sedimentation-desc: Project was initially allotted 15,000 ac-ft of storage for 100 yrs of sediment deposition below top of flood control; only 800 ac-ft expected to be deposited within the flood control pool between elevations 1342.0 & 1354.8
downstream-urban-desc: Anadarko, OK is located downstream from the dam on the mainstem of the Washita River in the Red River Basin.
bank-full-capacity-desc: Bankfull capacity at Anadarko, OK is 7,249 cfs (stage 19.0 ft).
